name: Castgate
blurb: Encased within a dome that holds the winter at bay, Castgate's picturesque beauty was earned through legendary battles against a goddess and an undead horde. Though its streets bustle with prosperity from gems and ships, the common folk work in the shadow of the very magic that shelters them.
selectorDescription: A prosperous dome-city that endures winter under old magic.

pointsOfInterest.description: This enchanting waterside tea house is a tranquil retreat where patrons can watch whimsical, color-changing Firenewts that bask in tabletop hearths and indicate the perfect tea temperature.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Frozen Rose
pointsOfInterest.description: Once a derelict tavern, this building was revitalized by the adventuring party Sub Rosa and transformed into a thriving hub for adventurers and locals.

detailSections.heading: Context
detailSections.body: Featuring frosted glass windows and a carved white rose emblem, the tavern is run by the quiet barkeep Thorn and serves as an informal guildhall for The Argentum Compact. Its walls are decorated with trophies from Sub Rosa’s adventures, making it a symbol of the town’s enduring resilience.
